name: Utagawa Kuniyoshi
contribution: One of the last great masters of the Japanese ukiyo-e style of woodblock prints and painting.
legacy: This person was one of the last great masters of the Japanese ukiyo-e style of woodblock prints and painting

checks.lead: Utagawa Kuniyoshi (Japanese: 歌川 国芳, [ɯ̟ta̠ɡa̠β̞a̠ kɯ̟ɲ̟iꜜjo̞ɕi]; 1 January 1798 – 14 April 1861) was one of the last great masters of the Japanese ukiyo-e style of woodblock prints and painting. He was a member of the Utagawa school.
